Dear Shruchi,

I don’t know if we’ll get the chance to do all of this together. So I made this game, because I promised you I would complete my bucket list, with you in it.

If life gives us the chance, I will do every single one of these with you in real life too. But the way things look right now, I’m not sure we’ll get it. We have very little time.

And I don’t want to be a distraction in your life. We both have so much going on. From what I’ve seen, we really enjoy being together, but maybe the timing isn’t right for you. UPSC is very important right now. My MBA plan matters to me too, and next year I’ll be leaving. After that, who knows where life takes us.

So this is a small gift, from me to you. Every chapter of my bucket list, lived with you, at least here. 💜

Rohit & Toby Jr. 🐕
